37: ## 8. Real GEE Satellite Metadata to Raster Export Pipeline Connection
38: 
39: ### Architecture Analysis: Catalog Acquisition vs. Raster Export
40: - **Catalog Metadata Acquisition (`POST /api/satellite/acquire`)**:
41:   - Implements M3 multi-satellite catalog discovery across Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, and Sentinel-1.
42:   - Queries Google Earth Engine REST API (`:listImages`), evaluates cloud coverage, clips to zone boundaries, and indexes metadata into MongoDB.
43:   - Intentionally lightweight and fast: stores metadata in MongoDB with `processingStatus: ACQUIRED` (or `CATALOG_ACQUIRED`) without triggering compute-heavy multi-band raster exports on every query.
44: - **Explicit Raster Export Pipeline (`POST /api/satellite/:id/export`)**:
45:   - Connects the selected real satellite metadata record to the existing production export pipeline (`GeeExportService`, `GeeTaskService`, `GoogleDriveService`, `GeoTiffService`).
46:   - Follows strict semantic stage progression without skip or simulated values.
47: 
48: ### Semantic Stage Pipeline
49: ```
50: CATALOG_ACQUIRED (or ACQUIRED)
51:         ↓
52: EXPORT_REQUESTED (POST /api/satellite/:id/export initiated)
53:         ↓
54: EXPORT_RUNNING (Real GEE v1alpha REST image:export task submitted)
55:         ↓
56: EXPORT_COMPLETED (GEE task state polled until COMPLETED)
57:         ↓
58: DRIVE_FILE_FOUND (File located in Google Drive, size > 0 bytes verified)
59:         ↓
60: DOWNLOADED (GeoTIFF streamed to local disk)
61:         ↓
62: RASTER_VALIDATED (Dimensions, bands, metric CRS normalized, pixel scale validated)
63:         ↓
64: PROCESSED (Spectral indices NDVI, NDWI, NDBI calculated)
65: ```
